gaps.description: CSS that needs a selector (states, pseudo-elements, structural selectors): a node only holds inline declarations, so no rule can be written.
No general style or attribute editor in the properties panel: only what the hand-written sections expose.
The AI generator validator only keeps style keys in CSS_PROP_SET.
Media queries beyond width: print, dark mode and reduced motion have no home.
The palette offers five tags and the properties panel cannot change a tag, so other elements come only from the AI generator or a default page template.
The AI generator validator only keeps its tag list: anything else becomes a div or is dropped.
At-rules: no way to store @keyframes, @container, @supports, @font-face and the rest.
Behaviour and state: no way to say that one element changes another.
The AI generator validator only keeps a short list of attributes.
Text mixed with elements: a node holds one string or children, and the renderers drop the string.
A stored value a renderer refuses, overwrites or loses.
Embedded content dropped by blockedNodes.ts (iframe, object, embed, ...), although these are ordinary content elements.
JSX that is a program, not markup: reported as left over by the static import, as the plan requires.
A tag that is also a component registry id renders as that entry instead: type "form" comes out as a div.
